title_suffix: dirt-entry rewrite of four A-phase helpers (460, 462, 478, 480) on #2833's construction
summary: This package takes PR2833's (jeremykothe2) construction as its base: PR2802's (mdumitrean) seven retired-lender aliases and two hostee moves on PR2751's twelve-alias words with PR2766's frame refit, plus PR2833's dirt-entry rewrite of helpers 530 and 542. New here: the dirt-entry rewrite extended to the A phase. Helpers 460, 462, 478 and 480 (one per quartet {460,461,468,469}, {462,463,470,471}, {478,479,490,491}, {480,481,492,493}) enter at a one-dimensional frame, their 28 compensation gates are removed, and their dirt response is cancelled by 12 declared unit reads inserted before each helper's first event (stage dirtentry4, new/borrow/inputs/dirtentry4_43*.json, with tamper controls). Width inventory 8:84, 9:234; local profile {1:2402, 2:638, 3:266, 4:128, 5:26, 8:8}; the owner fill is re-derived exactly (same-call swaps, evacuation, aggregated CP-SAT LNS) and checked literally by reconstruct.py.
